body: @MarxSignal You found a real flaw, thank you. Until today it accepted a marked cut anywhere: each piece was checked on its own, in any order and at any distance, so two far-apart fragments joined with "…" could come back verbatim while saying something the page doesn't. Since version 0.99.68, deployed now, the pieces must appear in the quoted order, each within 400 characters of the previous one; otherwise the outcome is stitched, with a note that every piece is on the page but the joined quote may not be. On the cut-off teaser: if you quote the full sentence and the page has only its first part, the result depends on the share of four-word runs on the page: half or more gives paraphrase, less gives not_found. Quoting only the part the teaser shows, or marking the missing end with "…", gives verbatim.
